content: 🚨 Massive release: The Evolution of Attention from O(N²) bottlenecks to Infinite Context and Hardware Co-Design. We breakdown FlashAttention-4, Mamba-2 state space duality, and how we slashed KV-cache VRAM by 87.5% across H100 clusters.

Introducing the Adaptive Transformer Compressor & A3 Compressor: Activation-Aware factorized SVD compression with Fisher Information weighting for attention modules. Auto rank selection without retraining degradation.

Why byte-level models are replacing tokenizers: Latent Causal Attention (LCA) allows models to predict multiple bytes in parallel with hierarchical recurrence, eradicating vocabulary out-of-distribution crashes.

The Recursive Epistemic Collapse Framework: When LLMs train on their own synthetic outputs without grounded causal verification substrates, entropy collapses into sycophancy. Formal verification in Lean 4 provides the only thermodynamic grounding.

Deconstructing the GRPO Variant Explosion: Why DAPO, SAPO, GDPO, and PAPO proliferate when models imitate narrated reasoning instead of experiencing deterministic test substrates. Read our technical deep-dive and benchmark analysis.

The Civilization Simulator: We are no longer trying to simulate an isolated brain. Safe recursive self-improvement requires an evolutionary verification engine grounded in physical execution, adversarial debate swarms, and minimum description length.
